[{"sha":"1a602b30e7aceb4134292a6e0e1d47a5de3b4f12","node_id":"C_kwDOE61uldoAKDFhNjAyYjMwZTdhY2ViNDEzNDI5MmE2ZTBlMWQ0N2E1ZGUzYjRmMTI","commit":{"author":{"name":"Ron Radtke","email":"dev@ikascripts.de","date":"2026-10-06T15:44:50Z"},"committer":{"name":"Ron Radtke","email":"dev@ikascripts.de","date":"2026-10-06T15:44:50Z"},"message":"chore(release): 1.1.0

Swift Package Manager support for React Native 0.87's autolinking, with the
Objective-C seam between the adapter and the Swift core that makes it possible.
URIUtil knows the content prefix; media.addDownload takes notification; auto and
binaryContentTypes are declared and a false auto is not sent; the Flow types match
index.d.ts; Android files every binary response under auto, as iOS does; fileCache
responses survive an outer OkHttp interceptor (#494). The wiki explains the 1.0 API.

Closes #365: a content:// URI is opened through its provider since 1.0, and the
content prefix is now recognised everywhere in JavaScript
